review:
A nine-line 2016 game where the princess wild doubles any win she completes.

Three scatters give 15 free spins with every win tripled and retriggers available, so a wild win in the bonus pays 6x. High volatility, a 9,000x max and an excellent 97.1% RTP. Free spins roughly once every 156 spins. The game that led to Lady Wolf Moon and Fortune Bells.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
